info.title: GSharp cs2gs C# to G# translator
info.description: Command-line tool (`cs2gs`) that translates C# source to GSharp. Requires a .NET 10 runtime.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: cs2gs - C# to G# migration tool (ADR-0115

options.name: --corpus
options.description: Source repository root (default: tools/cs2gs/corpus).

options.name: --out
options.description:
Empty destination repository (required by default).
Output location for report.html + summary.json (default: the run dir).
A trailing slash or an existing directory is always a directory.
A path ending in .html/.htm/.json (or an existing file) names that one
output file directly; the other artifact keeps its default name
alongside it. Any other path is created as a directory.

options.name: --diagnostic-run
options.description: Preserve the historical timestamped corpus/CI layout.

options.name: --app
options.description: Diagnostic-run only; migrate one app (repeatable).

options.name: --gsc
options.description: Override gsc.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Compiler/gsc.dll).

options.name: --gsgen
options.description:
Override gsgen.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Gsgen.Cli/gsgen.dll); issue #2215.
With --diagnostic-run, --out is the runs root.

options.name: --config
options.description: Build config used to find gsc (default: Release).

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Repository migration only: exclude apps whose repo-relative id
starts with <path> (repeatable; e2e fixtures, non-app projects).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
NEW or REGRESSED fingerprints; known-open gaps are tolerated.
--baseline-strict Also fail on STALE ledger entries (nightly mode).

options.name: --test-allowlist
options.description:
Test-parity failure allow-list (issue #3885); default:
<corpus>/tools/cs2gs/selfmig-test-allowlist.json when present.

options.name: --via-sdk
options.description: Build emitted G# via 'dotnet build' + Gsharp.NET.Sdk (default).

options.name: --no-via-sdk
options.description: Use the legacy direct-gsc compile path.

options.name: --translate-only
options.description:
Repository migration only (issue #3668): run stage 1 across the WHOLE
repository and stop, writing a per-app validation-context.json so
'cs2gs validate' shards can run stages 2-4 in parallel elsewhere.

options.name: --format
options.description: Run the ADR-0179 gsfmt post-pass (opt-in phase 7a).

options.name: --no-format
options.description: Keep the printer layout (default).

options.name: --run
options.description: Existing run directory containing run.json (required).

options.name: --write
options.description:
Append skeleton rows for new Roslyn node kinds, canonicalize the
construct inventory, and regenerate the docs matrix + surface golden.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description:
A migrate run also writes report.html + summary.json into the run dir automatically (ADR-0115 §F).
Exit code is non-zero if any app fails a stage (so CI can gate).

construct inventory, and regenerate the docs matrix + surface golden.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description:
A migrate run also writes report.html + summary.json into the run dir automatically (ADR-0115 §F).
Exit code is non-zero if any app fails a stage (so CI can gate).

options.name: --corpus
options.description: Source repository root (default: tools/cs2gs/corpus).

options.name: --out
options.description: Empty destination repository (required by default).

options.name: --diagnostic-run
options.description: Preserve the historical timestamped corpus/CI layout.

options.name: --app
options.description: Diagnostic-run only; migrate one app (repeatable).

options.name: --gsc
options.description: Override gsc.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Compiler/gsc.dll).

options.name: --gsgen
options.description:
Override gsgen.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Gsgen.Cli/gsgen.dll); issue #2215.
With --diagnostic-run, --out is the runs root.

options.name: --config
options.description: Build config used to find gsc (default: Release).

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
Repository migration only: exclude apps whose repo-relative id
starts with <path> (repeatable; e2e fixtures, non-app projects).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
NEW or REGRESSED fingerprints; known-open gaps are tolerated.
--baseline-strict Also fail on STALE ledger entries (nightly mode).

options.name: --test-allowlist
options.description:
Test-parity failure allow-list (issue #3885); default:
<corpus>/tools/cs2gs/selfmig-test-allowlist.json when present.

options.name: --via-sdk
options.description: Build emitted G# via 'dotnet build' + Gsharp.NET.Sdk (default).

options.name: --no-via-sdk
options.description: Use the legacy direct-gsc compile path.

options.name: --translate-only
options.description:
Repository migration only (issue #3668): run stage 1 across the WHOLE
repository and stop, writing a per-app validation-context.json so
'cs2gs validate' shards can run stages 2-4 in parallel elsewhere.

options.name: --format
options.description: Run the ADR-0179 gsfmt post-pass (opt-in phase 7a).

options.name: --no-format
options.description: Keep the printer layout (default).

options.name: --run
options.description: Existing run directory containing run.json (required).

options.name: --out
options.description:
Output location for report.html + summary.json (default: the run dir).
A trailing slash or an existing directory is always a directory.
A path ending in .html/.htm/.json (or an existing file) names that one
output file directly; the other artifact keeps its default name
alongside it. Any other path is created as a directory.

options.name: --corpus
options.description: The ORIGINAL repository root the tree was migrated from (required).

options.name: --migrated
options.description: The already-migrated tree to validate (required).

options.name: --artifacts
options.description: Runs root for this shard's logs/triage (default: <migrated>.cs2gs-runs).

options.name: --manifests
options.description:
The migrate run directory holding per-app validation-context.json
(default: the newest run directory under --artifacts).

options.name: --app
options.description: Validate this app (repeatable).

options.name: --shard
options.description: Validate every Nth app starting at i (1-based); excludes --app.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
MUST match the migrate pass exactly — it defines the discovered set,
not the executed subset. Narrowing it breaks reference resolution.

options.name: --config
options.description: Build config used to find gsc and the SDK package (default: Release).

options.description: Override gsc.dll.
